o(*￣▽￣*)ブ Thank you everyone for waiting. There were indeed many issues at launch, but I believe with our hair-loss-inducing efforts, we can basically resolve the critical Bugs within the next few days, and complete most optimizations within 1-2 weeks.

We hope everyone can provide more feedback and ideas. We will carefully consider each one and implement them step by step.

Many friends have mentioned that the fluency is much worse compared to the Demo. Indeed... because we wanted to add too much content, and there's even a lot of content that has been partially developed in secret. We bit off more than we could chew, leading to many aspects being imperfect.

Therefore, we will quickly stabilize the current version to provide a better experience. Once the Bugs are mostly resolved, we will unveil new gameplay and content.

notes.title: Day 1 Bug Fixing Update & The Future 'Brand New Experience'
notes.content:
[b]1. Optimized the entrances for [Tianshu], [Arithmetic], [Sell/Orders/Curios], and [Traits], making them easier to access.
2. The in-game store now has more detailed categories; items are no longer all mixed together.
3. Fixed the issue where the Wilderness difficulty was too high in the second round.
4. Fixed issues related to the Yanling Workshop (Research Spirit Workshop).
5. Buildings like the Cave Dwelling (Abode) and Arithmetic Academy can now be clicked to directly jump to their respective view screens.
6. A confirmation pop-up will now appear if the Breakthrough process is interrupted.
7. Improved the guidance tasks and explanations for the Breakthrough process.
8. Improved the description of Breakthrough Pills.
9. Optimized the tips shown during Cave Dwelling (Abode) Breakthrough.
10. Fixed an issue where recipes could not be used.
11. Fixed an issue where double-clicking to use a Breakthrough Pill would cause it to disappear.
12. Fixed an issue where debris (wreckage/remains) could not be used.[/b]

Thank you all for your patience! We know there were quite a few issues right after launch, but we believe in our hair-losing (problem-solving) abilities! Serious bugs should basically be resolved within the next few days, and most optimizations should be completed within 1-2 weeks.

We hope you will provide more feedback and ideas. We will seriously consider each one and work on implementing them gradually.

Many friends have mentioned that the smoothness isn't as good as the Demo's... Indeed... because we wanted to add too much content, and there's even a lot of content that's secretly half-finished. We bit off more than we could chew, leading to many aspects not being polished.

Therefore, we will quickly stabilize the current version to provide a better experience for everyone. Once the bugs are mostly fixed, we will publicly share the new gameplay and content. Believe that each time will be a 'completely new experience'~!

notes.title: On September 13th, Ascension Begins! 200+ Hours of Gameplay Await!
notes.content:
Body:
Fellow cultivators, thank you for your patience!
This time, on September 13th, it's final!
In the official version, you will experience:
[b]200+ Hours of Content[/b]  
The early demo only included the first realm, offering about 6 hours of gameplay. The full version will feature 12 realms, with total playtime exceeding 200 hours.  

[b]Richer Buildings & Terrain[/b]  
More buildings with diverse effects, and enhanced interactions between buildings and terrain.  

[b]Designed Maps[/b]  
Early maps relied heavily on random generation, leading to scattered resources and poor exploration pacing. For the full version, we've designed multiple optimized maps that retain some randomness while incorporating intentional design elements, ensuring more reasonable exploration pacing for each map.  

[b]More Varied Monsters & Design[/b]  
Many players noted monsters used skills too quickly, impacting combat feel. We've redesigned existing monsters and added many new types. Monster skills and combat pacing have also been optimized.  

[b]Unified Management Interface[/b]  
Players found building operations cumbersome. We've consolidated these interfaces to make operations as unified and convenient as possible.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715918/5e3f3627e62d42ad77f5a0c741a960fbec5f16c0.png[/img]  

[b]Improved Visuals[/b]  
Terrain and building icons have been optimized for a more cohesive style.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715918/628c8947c221406bb45ce3370cf889bf8b666b3e.jpg[/img]  

[b]One-Click Exploration[/b]  
Players mentioned manual exploration felt tedious. We've added one-click exploration: disciples will automatically explore marked areas. If they encounter an impassable adventure, they'll retry after leveling up. Now you can AFK longer without worrying about disciples slacking off!  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715918/b49e435522dbde1689fae21135d2b79b3298856b.jpg[/img]  

[b]More Direct Progression Feedback[/b]  
We added the [Celestial Hub] system. Here, you can spend resources to quickly boost various abilities. Our goal is to let you make significant progress upon returning after time away.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715918/1401d17ca6837269211cce56dfe09cd5fea2b919.jpg[/img]  

[b]Orders & Rare Treasures[/b]  
1. We designed an Order system as a more cost-effective alternative to direct selling. After building the [Contract Office], you can receive Orders via the [Celestial Hub]. Fulfilling them yields massive rewards.  
2. You can also purchase exotic treasures (rare divine abilities, artifacts, internal techniques, etc.) from the Rare Treasures Pavilion.  

[b]Complete Production Chain[/b]  
This might sound standard, but unlike the demo, the full version lets you: Alchemy, Decompose, Smelt, Enhance, Nurture, and craft various auxiliary items.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715918/a6183816a0598adb41c2cd0ab3497efbe81764d8.jpg[/img]  

[b]More Dungeon Types[/b]  
1. Beyond standard exploration and lair adventures, we've added new types.  
2. Secret Realms: Repeatable challenges with unique rewards. Difficulty and rewards increase with each layer.  
3. Faction (Camps): Face human cultivators (not just monsters) who wield divine abilities and artifacts.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715918/a68aded075f4e4f0ca7bd91e117fd43432f79a9b.jpg[/img]  

[b]Automation Settings[/b]  
We've improved the AFK experience with Automation Settings.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715918/d790362d5fce0d8a246c44ad7f2204cf9191b045.png[/img]  

[b]Optimized Dominion Challenges[/b]  
We clarified objectives for each stage and designed hundreds of corresponding monsters.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715918/27e38a6359ea7604e22eb1eb6ff3adfec275f0e6.jpg[/img]  

[b]Richer Divine Miracles[/b]  
As exploration progresses, you'll unlock and upgrade more Divine Miracles. Higher-level Miracles let you smite enemies with divine punishment (consuming significant Faith).  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715918/5d4205011d5407c65f6383f1f3930530099a4ee1.jpg[/img]  

[b]Tag-Team Battles[/b]  
Players requested group battles. While overhauling core combat wasn't feasible, we implemented a tag-team mode with multiple disciples and enemies. More modes may come later.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715918/4aa39988d182efbf4af8b382e1e6f581487f0dc8.jpg[/img]  

[b]New Combat Visuals[/b]  
1. Added more VFX and combat animations.  
2. Optimized overall screen layout.  

[b]More Equipment, Artifacts, Divine Abilities & Internal Techniques[/b]  
Added offline acceleration – progress while sleeping, working, or slacking off!  

[b]Gaze Interface Optimized[/b]  
We spruced up the Gaze interface for more fun.  

[b]Chaotic Disasters & Rewards[/b]  
1. The full version includes a Cataclysm system (suggested by a player!). Different disasters present unique challenges, requiring you to adapt your strategy.  
2. Events will also occur; your choices lead to varied consequences—from useless resources to breakthroughs for stuck disciples.  

[b]Disciple Traits Implemented[/b]  
Traits were underutilized in the demo. The full version implements hundreds of unique Disciple Traits. Extract traits via Divine Miracles to craft your perfect Emissaries.  

[b]Other Optimizations[/b]  
Many smaller tweaks:  
- You can now gather herbs and plant simultaneously (previously restricted).  
- Added clearer guidelines during building placement.  
- Buildings retain work assignments and disciple counts after upgrading.  
- Capped frame rates to prevent excessive GPU usage.  
- (And more we can't fully recall!)  
Finally, thank you for your constant support. See you in the official release!

notes.title: The Eastern Sacrifice | Wishing All Cultivators a Prosperous Year of the Snake!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are Wutiao Shrimp Studio,  
First off, let us wish all our friends an early Happy New Year!  

***The Eastern Sacrifice*** is an idle cultivation management game with sect-building elements. Since the release of the playable demo, we’ve received a lot of bug reports and optimization suggestions. We’re incredibly grateful to all of you😭—your feedback has been a huge help, and we’ll continue to work hard!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715918/48caaa7ce83fa3b67bbf2733e77a6f0439695db5.jpg[/img]  

Feel free to add the game to your Steam wishlist and try the demo 

★ *The Eastern Sacrifice* combines idle management gameplay with Lovecraftian-inspired cultivation themes. In the chaotic and frenzied world of cultivation, fight evil spirits, gather rare materials, and build a devoted sect that worships you as their supreme leader. Gather faith to construct your divine golden avatar and ascend to claim supreme powers, becoming the legendary Grand Arbiter.  

Following the Lunar New Year, we plan to release a demo update in late February! Here's a sneak peek at what’s coming:  

---

### **• Disciple Traits**
1. **Custom Backgrounds:** Zhang Xiaofan, Ye Fan, and Shi Hao will now feature unique traits based on their backstories. Incoming disciples from outside the sect will also draw from an expanded pool of random traits.  
   Whether you attract prodigies with divine talents or freeloaders with little use depends on the strength of your sect's faith!  
2. **Trait Preferences:** Disciples will now have varied preferences, such as higher HP, stronger martial arts damage, faster cultivation speeds, or affinity with specific skill branches.  
3. **New Buffs and Skill Adjustments:** We've added fresh buffs and updated skills to enhance gameplay diversity.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715918/70dd9e5a66d1cc8fcc650c2dbd0cc78736908f6e.jpg[/img]  

---

### **• Mystic Trials**
1. Every time disciples are sent to explore a mystic realm, they’ll return with loot—but the paths to the same realm may disappear upon their next visit.  
   Mystic realms are unpredictable, and when exploration reaches its limit, the realm upgrades. This might yield richer resources or deadlier enemies.  
2. **Elite Monsters:** New elite enemy designs are being tested.  
3. **Combat Tutorial Enhancements:** Improved guidance for combat systems.  

---

### **• Sect Administration Hall**
1. **Daoists of Steel:** Identify mortals with unique physical and spiritual traits, erase their emotions, and engrave seals upon their bodies. These Daoists will possess extraordinary strength, remain tireless, and obey your commands without question.  
2. **Auto-Recycling:** Idle or unproductive Daoists can now be automatically recycled.  
   **Auto-Allocation:** Daoists will only be assigned to already-active projects without initiating new work or production tasks.  
3. **Workflow Customization:** Added functional entries and judgments for subsystems, enabling players to tailor workflows for better management.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715918/975932a2bd04b3657f17b8fa5e61a901358e3356.jpg[/img]  

---

### **• Reincarnation System**
1. **Inherited Resources:** Adjustments to resource inheritance conditions for new runs.  
2. **Loading Screen & Animation:** Added visual flair for reincarnation sequences.  
3. **Remapped Worlds:** Re-rolled maps after reincarnation.  
   (New reincarnation and cycle-related content is currently in development and on its way!)  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715918/d07ed1b69f124138db0f6d14817239b42f53ec7e.jpg[/img]  

---

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715918/937661254de51172fe06cf1f808435e1618dc116.png[/img]  

As another year unfolds, we’re deeply grateful for your love and support for *The Eastern Sacrifice* throughout 2024.  
From all of us at Wutiao Shrimp Studio, we wish you a joyful, prosperous, and peaceful 2025! (*^▽^*)  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715918/3f85d7af0233dfdf898afbe18bbff7804878c3ba.jpg[/img]  

♥ Join us! ♥  
Official *The Eastern Sacrifice* Player Group:
Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/S7G9jM3fYh  ][/url]

Stay up to date with the latest news about *The Eastern Sacrifice* and interact with the dev team in real-time. Your feedback is invaluable, and we deeply appreciate your suggestions and ideas. See you there!  

Drop your New Year’s wishes in the comments—we’ll make them all come true with likes!
